# SPEC_TEMPLATE.md

This is the official SPEC template for new features. Copy this file to `docs/features/<feature>/SPEC.md` when starting a new feature.

## 1. Problem Statement

- Clear, concise description of the problem being solved.

## 2. Scope

- What is in scope for this feature.
- What is explicitly out of scope.

## 3. Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement |
| ---- | ------------ |
| FR-1 | ... |
| FR-2 | ... |

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements

- Performance requirements
- Security requirements
- Reliability targets

## 5. Contracts & APIs

### 5.1 Ports (domain/)

- `...`

### 5.2 Use Cases (application/)

- `...`

### 5.3 Adapters (infrastructure/)

- `...`

## 6. Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 7. Security Considerations

- Input validation requirements
- Secret handling guidelines
- Authentication/authorization needs

## 8. Dependencies

- New package dependencies
- Database/schema changes
- External service contracts
